difficulty_reason: The theorem, attributed in the text to Andre and carrying a literature reference for its hardest implication, gives four equivalent conditions for a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings whose base has regular completion map: regularity, flatness with geometrically regular special fibre, flatness with formal smoothness of the fibre, and formal smoothness of the map itself. The proof quotes the equivalence of the last three conditions from the earlier proposition and observes that regularity implies flatness with geometrically regular fibre, so that the substance reduces to deriving regularity from formal smoothness of the map, which the text then carries out in the remainder of the argument.
